TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREA ESR668 STOCKHOLM CITY MITT IS 
ESTABLISHED 
FOR AVIATION OPERATIONS. WITHIN THIS AREA 591947N 0180328E RADIUS 
1NM, ALL AIR TRAFFIC NOT PARTICIPATING IN THE ACTIVITY IS 
PROHIBITED. MILITARY FLIGHTS, POLICE, AMBULANCE, THE COAST GUARD, 
SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR) OPERATIONS, AND RESCUE SERVICES IN 
ACCORDANCE WITH CIVIL PROTECTION ACT (2003:778), ALL OF THEM WHEN ON 
MISSION, AND TRAFFIC TO/FROM BROMMA AIRPORT, ARE EXEMPT FROM THE 
RESTRICTIONS AND MAY TRANSIT THE AREA UPON OBTAINING PERMISSION FROM 
BROMMA ATS. NON EXEMPTED TRAFFIC CAN APPLY FOR EXEMPTION WITH THE 
POLICE AUTHORITY TEL +46(0)725032851.
